lines.text: The LORD tells Israel not to fear, for He has redeemed them and the flames will not set them ablaze.
God will bring them from the east, gather them from the north, and tell the south to give them up.
The nations are told to bring witnesses, but the LORD says His own people are His witnesses and chosen servant.
The LORD says there is no Savior but Him, and He alone decreed, saved and proclaimed, not some golden god.
